reviewer.context: Fresh delegated successor-candidate review with isolated-clone and adversarial evidence inspection.

checks.name: exact-candidate-and-path-identity
checks.postcondition: The candidate commit, tree, 114-path NUL-delimited digest, and exact HE-001 through HE-004 requirement/task crosswalk reproduce.

checks.name: clean-clone-portability-and-governance
checks.postcondition: An isolated clone passed focused governance, type, skill, path, and full repository verification after the repository's normal build preparation; 0654 and 0744 owner-execute semantics are corrected.

checks.name: he-mapping-and-skill-projection
checks.postcondition: Six canonical skills, two overlays, two declared extras, eight relative Claude links, complete local references, and their content-addressed projections agree.

checks.name: journeys-and-retained-failures
checks.postcondition: Five zero-exit candidate-bound journey receipts and all three rejected predecessor records are complete, distinct, hash-bound, and retained.

checks.name: preserved-surfaces-and-no-changeset
checks.postcondition: HGI-203 through HGI-206 evidence, packages/apps, workflows, runbooks, authority controls, critical-journey owner, public content, lockfile, and Changesets are unchanged; package-facing behaviour does not require a Changeset.

checks.name: evaluator-adversarial-and-external-nonclaims
checks.postcondition: Omission, duplicate, stale projection, forged identity, temporal ordering, circularity, and external-claim routes fail closed; evaluator typecheck, lint, format, diff, and source-hash readback pass.

limitations: The reviewer inspected the five candidate-bound journey receipts but did not independently rerun those five expensive commands.
Clean-clone full verification required normal build preparation because of the documented pre-existing Knip dependency on generated docs-fumadocs output.
Acceptance qualifies only the named local candidate, environment, receipts, and epoch evidence.
nonClaims: No push, remote Git, hosted CI, registry, release, deployment, provider, public-site, or external-consumer state was accessed or established.
